text: {"lessons":["My account fluctuated while I made no trades, so I should avoid reacting to every monthly move and make decisions for a clear reason.","Buying all five stocks in the same month gave me exposure to each, but equal share counts did not mean equal amounts invested; I should consider position sizes and keep cash needs in mind.","I bought after several months of ups and downs, but I don't yet know how those purchases will perform; I should review each stock's price history and avoid assuming recent moves predict what comes next."]}
